name: snr_textured
description: Temporal RAW noise measurement of a stationary five-object textured scene

geometry.depth_reference: Front of lens at x=100 mm; objects at 1400, 1500, 1700, 1200 and 1100 mm (left to right)

focus: Fixed lens focus and camera orientation
roi_definition: Fixed textured-object ROI selected during RAW analysis; exclude object edges, glare and shadows. Temporal noise calculated from the same registered pixels across all 24 frames.
notes: Five stationary product boxes at measured depths 1100, 1200, 1400, 1500 and 1700 mm. Same arrangement as lf_layers_5obj_01. Camera fixed at x=100 mm. Capture 24 consecutive RAW images without moving camera, objects or illumination. Exposure 32000 µs, gain 4×, AE disabled. Texture, printed graphics and surface reflectivity present; temporal noise will be measured from identical registered pixel locations.
protocol_notes: Temporal RAW SNR needs fixed camera/lighting and a documented ROI; use separate uniform/dark sessions if needed.
